messages:
mina: Quick alert 1 Raj (SWE) is starting Mon at Tokyo satellite. He has a passport that expires Apr 20. We need to confirm I-9 verification approach and whether we can do badge same-day.

vik: Short answer: I-9 requires docs to be unexpired on verification date. Since this is international onboarding under US payroll, we need a notarized review or an authorized agent at the hub.

akiko: We have an onsite staffer who can act as authorized verifier for the hub, but they need docs uploaded in advance and security clearance. If we want mobile notary, earliest slot is 08:30 JST.

mina: Prefer mobile notary at 08:30 so Raj can drop by for badge pickup at ~10:30. Can facilities prepare a temporary badge if verification completes?

talib: Facilities can issue a day-1 temp badge. Requirements from security: passport photo page, I-9 attestation PDF from notary or verifier note, and signed badge policy.

mina: Copying the checklist here so Raj knows exactly what to upload. akiko, confirm if the hub can take the scan via secure upload link.

akiko: Yes. Use our secure intake form (link posted in DM). We'll also need a local contact name for pickup.

badge-bot: Security ticket created: SEC-2321. ETA approval ~40-60 minutes after intake. Badge pickup code will be posted once badge is provisioned.

mina: Checklist (paste to Raj):
```
- passport photo page (color scan)
- mobile notary attestation or authorized-hub-verifier note (PDF)
- signed badge policy (e-sign OK)
- completed remote I-9 form ID section (people-ops will review)
- pickup window (10:30-11:30 JST) and local contact (akiko@redwood)
```

talib: One more note: if passport expiry <30 days after start date, we should flag relocation/visa team to confirm work authorization timelines. People-ops can queue follow-up.

mina: Good point. akiko, please also confirm a workstation and temporary laptop reservation; Rafael on IT will ghost-assign once security ticket is green.

akiko: Will do. Rafael, can you reserve a loaner laptop for Raj Mon morning? @rafael

rafael: Yep I can. Reserving a loaner and creating AD account provisioning ticket.

mina: Raj, can you confirm you can make the notary slot Mon 08:30 JST and upload passport + signed badge policy to the secure intake link? If not, we can swap to hub-verifier.

raj: I can do 08:30 notary. Uploading passport scan and e-signed badge policy now. Thanks!

mina: Received the uploads. Forwarding to security and notary attestation when done. Will update with badge pickup code. :raised_hands:
